name: Rasan Information Technology Company
note: Tadawul 8313, listed June 2024 (30% IPO). At the IPO the 5%+ holders were Impact46's fund vehicles (custodian SPVs for its VC funds) and the founding individuals (Theib AlMutairi 9.91%, Muheideb AlMuheideb 8.58%, Samer Raslan 6.60% post-offering; prospectus table 1.2). Impact46 sold its entire remaining Rasan stake (~17.16%) in an accelerated bookbuild announced 2025-03-13 (impact46.sa), leaving the named founders as the disclosed 5%+ holders alongside free float.
